LanguageData.CC_Settings_TraitChanges_Tip: Now and then, after a long stretch of the same kind of life, one of a colonist's traits grows, appears or fades: steadier nerves after raid after raid held, kindness after years of kindnesses, a pessimist after a year of graves. Each change comes with a letter that tells what led to it, with dates, and is kept on the character page. Rare: at most one change per colonist in 60 days, and one in the colony in 10. Traits of the body, sexuality and traits from genes or a backstory never change.
LanguageData.CC_SetNote_TraitChanges: Rarely, a trait grows, appears or fades after what a colonist went through.
LanguageData.CC_TC_Absorbed: The trait now holds what had already changed in {PAWN_objective}, so {PAWN_possessive} character stays where it was, and that part of the change is for good.
